activity_summary: You boarded at threepence, the second meal of the week. The hose are your mother's, and they stayed. Hobbins took four lines: Wednesday, by Oxford, the bridge on Friday by dusk, and he leaves today. The long letter is still on the board, with no day. You gave no new plot. The firing sixpence was not collected. The chamber was left as a Tuesday question.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Named the four lines, kept the long letter, and offered no plot.

entities.name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell
entities.context: Counted the second meal, asked with the dish in her hand, and waived a verdict.

entities.name: Alse Pinder
entities.context: Named the stitch in the hose, and left the unread page unread.

entities.name: Gillis Verbeke
entities.context: Ate, and left the letters to the people who write them.

quotes.speaker: dorcas_ansell
quotes.text: Sunday was the first. This is the second.

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: It has no day in it. It did not go.

quotes.speaker: dorcas_ansell
quotes.text: Then I am not owed a verdict.
